text_block_list.text: (CRACK!)

Suddenly, from somewhere in the corner of 
the room, the sound of something ringing 
echoed...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I know... but............ you're 
right...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. It seems she's worried about 
me............

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry. I caused worry for both you, 
Trainer, and my "friends"...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...I know that letting this get to me... 
is wrong, but..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...I know that letting this get to me... 
is wrong, but..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so, I wonder...
(CRACK!)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu... You're right... That might very 
well be the case...
choice_data_list: Huh, are you really saying that?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Well... they are mostly the same, I 
believe...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Although... the exact meaning doesn't 
matter. ...What matters is that they both 
put their trust in me...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Just that... is more than enough for me...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... both of you... Next time... I 
will win...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...To myself......

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That's true, isn't it... We cannot afford 
to give in to the darkness within... 
right...?
(CRACK!)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. If both of you are telling me the 
same thing... I guess I have no choice.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... both of you... I will... do 
my best...
